objective.text: Multiply big numbers and multiples of 10. Use place value patterns and the properties.

explanations.title: Units
explanations.text: Think in units. 4 times 3 tens is 12 tens. 12 tens is 120.

explanations.title: Properties
explanations.text: 4 tens times 3 tens is (4 times 3) times (10 times 10). That is 12 times 100, or 1,200.

explanations.title: Zeros pattern
explanations.text: 60 times 50 is (6 times 5) times (10 times 10). 6 times 5 is 30. Then 30 times 100 is 3,000.

explanations.title: Distributive
explanations.text: For 451 times 8, break 451 into 400, 50, and 1. Multiply each part by 8. Add the products.

examples.title: 4 times 30
examples.text: 4 times 3 tens is 12 tens. 12 tens is 120. So 4 times 30 is 120.

examples.title: 40 times 300
examples.text: (4 times 3) times (10 times 100) is 12 times 1,000. That is 12,000.

examples.title: 451 times 8
examples.text: 400 times 8 is 3,200. 50 times 8 is 400. 1 times 8 is 8. The sum is 3,608.

objective.text: Estimate products. Round each factor to an easy basic fact and use place value patterns.

explanations.title: Round to basic fact
explanations.text: To estimate 456 times 42, round to 500 times 40. 5 hundreds times 4 tens is 20 thousands. The estimate is 20,000.

explanations.title: Compare sizes
explanations.text: If both factors are 10 times as large, the product is about 100 times as large. Test it with estimates.

examples.title: 1320 times 88
